name: chthonic-archive
description: VS Code workspace extension for the Chthonic Archive — themes, status bar, sidebar, and SSOT tools.

commands.title: Chthonic: Start Next Cockpit (bun --bun next dev)

chthonic.ssotPath.description: Path to the SSOT file (relative to workspace root).

chthonic.showSSOTHash.description: Show SSOT hash in status bar.

chthonic.showLineage.description: Show active lineage indicator in status bar.

chthonic.entropy.enabled.description: Enable dynamic entropy analysis and explorer decay decoration overlay.

chthonic.entropy.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files scanned by the entropy worker.

chthonic.entropy.scanIntervalMs.description: Background entropy rescan interval in milliseconds.

chthonic.entropy.decorationBatchSize.description: Maximum URI updates emitted per FileDecorationProvider flush.

chthonic.entropy.polyglotEnabled.description: Enable uv/Ruby sidecars, Merkle accumulation, and Solana settlement scaffolding.

chthonic.entropy.pythonScanIntervalMs.description: Interval for uv-managed ruff sidecar scans.

chthonic.entropy.ledgerSettleDebounceMs.description: Debounce window for Merkle settlement writes triggered by save/commit.

chthonic.entropy.ledgerMode.description: Ledger backend mode. 'validator' uses the Rust sidecar host; 'bankrun' uses in-memory simulation.

chthonic.entropy.solanaRpcUrl.description: RPC URL for local Solana validator settlement probes.

chthonic.entropy.solanaAutostartValidato.description: Attempt to autostart solana-test-validator in the workspace.

chthonic.entropy.solanaLedgerHostBinaryP.description: Optional absolute path to the Rust entropy-ledger-host binary.

chthonic.entropy.solanaWalletPath.description: Optional absolute path to payer keypair JSON for the Rust ledger host.

chthonic.entropy.solanaIdlPath.description: Optional absolute path to the Anchor IDL consumed by the Rust ledger host.

chthonic.reactor.enabled.description: Enable the Entropy Reactor (ANNO + Vulkan compute daemon).

chthonic.reactor.headlessVulkan.description: Enable headless Vulkan compute for sediment layer calculation. Falls back to CPU if unavailable.

chthonic.reactor.daemonBinaryPath.description: Optional absolute path to the chthonic-daemon binary.

chthonic.reactor.transport.description: Sediment transport mode. 'auto' prefers shared memory synapse and falls back to JSONL.

chthonic.reactor.cockpitAutoLayout.description: Automatically apply Cockpit layout (terminal right, editor center) on activation.

chthonic.slab.selfHealingEnabled.description: Enable periodic slab self-healing via endoflife.date checks and mise upgrade.

chthonic.slab.selfHealingIntervalMs.description: Background slab self-healing interval in milliseconds.

chthonic.slab.eolApiBase.description: Base URL for endoflife lifecycle API used by slab self-healing.

chthonic.webCockpit.url.description: URL for the Bun/Next training cockpit opened from extension commands.

chthonic.webCockpit.autoStart.description: Auto-start the Bun/Next cockpit dev server when Chthonic Archive activates.

scripts.verify:host: bun run scripts/toolpool-scan.ts --quiet && bun run scripts/verify-host.ts
scripts.build:ledger: bun run scripts/verify-host.ts && bun run scripts/build-ledger.ts
scripts.build:wasm: bun run scripts/verify-host.ts && bun run scripts/build-wasm.ts
scripts.build:daemon: bun run scripts/verify-host.ts && bun run scripts/build-daemon.ts
scripts.build:synapse: bun run scripts/verify-host.ts && bun run scripts/build-synapse.ts
scripts.build:all: bun run build:ledger && bun run build:wasm && bun run build:daemon && bun run build:synapse && bun run compile
scripts.compile: bun build src/extension.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs --external vscode --minify && bun build src/entropy/entropyWorker.ts --outfile dist/entropy-worker.js --target node --format cjs --minify
scripts.watch: bun build src/extension.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs --external vscode --watch
scripts.watch:worker: bun build src/entropy/entropyWorker.ts --outfile dist/entropy-worker.js --target node --format cjs --watch
